# Code Anchors: Shipped Payload

- `libs/portable-tools/src/release-payload.ts` — the stated set: the parts walked, the ignore filter and its call site (now empty), the canonical manifest and its code-unit sort.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/release-payload.spec.ts` — the stated set's properties, including that entries the filter once excluded now ship or are absent for structural reasons rather than filtered ones.
- `libs/portable-tools/payload-manifest.json` — the per-file manifest — staged position and content digest, diagnostic only — regenerated with the set it describes.
- `libs/portable-tools/bundle-fingerprint.json` — the two-entry pin, the sole pass-or-fail authority, regenerated in the same story that changed the set.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/release-gate.ts`, `libs/portable-tools/src/release-gate.spec.ts` — reads what this payload carries to decide whether a shipped body's reference still resolves after an install.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/vendor-components.ts` — defines the managed component subtrees this set is assembled from.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/pack-release.ts`, `libs/portable-tools/src/pack-release.spec.ts` — stages exactly this set into the release tree, and proves no excluded category survives the walk.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/component-invocations.ts` — reads the same set of shipped bodies, so no shipped body escapes the gate.
